annotations.title: Consent to mirror a Forge vault

description: Consent to mirror a Forge vault's signals into YOUR OWN account (POST /forge/vaults/{vault_id}/mirrors). Requires vault_id, account_address (your checksummed 0x address) and rules_hash (the vault's current hash from forge_signals — a stale one is refused with the current hash). Optional max_order_usd and max_leverage are YOUR caps; plans never exceed them. You cannot mirror your own vault. Needs your agent key (X-NW-User-Key) with the sign scope. Consent lapses if the vault changes its rules; consent again to the new hash. NightWatch never holds your key and places no order.

max_order_usd.description: Optional: your per-order cap in USD
